messages:
Nora Blake: Bad luck  my bag didn't arrive and the airline says delayed 48-72h. Bought essentials (toothbrush, toiletries, one outfit) on personal card. Can we get reimbursed and do we file an insurance claim?
people-ops-bot: Policy extract -> baggage delays: immediate essentials up to $75 per 24-hour period (max $200) are reimbursable with receipts for business trips. Also travel insurance claims may cover additional amounts. See: https://intranet/redwood/te/baggage (auto-note)
Samir Patel: Practical steps: file an expense for "Baggage Delay - Essentials" with photo of receipts + the airline delay confirmation. If you have travel insurance (purchased via TMC), file with insurer and include insurer claim number in Concur.
Leah Kim: We use the TMC's insurance bundle for most corporate bookings. travel-tmc-bot can confirm if your PNR included insurance. If not, finance will still reimburse up to policy cap but insurance claim is separate.
travel-tmc-bot: Checking PNR... your booking (PNR ABC123) did include the TMC insurance rider. Please start a claim at https://tmcclaims.example/ and paste the claim ID in your expense. We'll assist with insurer follow-up.
Finance Bot: Audit tips -> required attachments: airline delay confirmation (screenshot or email), itemized receipts for purchases, card statement showing charge. For multi-day delays: submit one claim per day or a single claim with receipts and a note showing dates. We reimburse up to $75 per 24-hr period, max $200 per incident, unless insurer covers more.
Nora Blake: If I bought a replacement jacket that was $180 because I had to present to a customer, is that allowed?
Samir Patel: That probably exceeds the immediate essentials cap. Put it in Concur as "Baggage - Exceptional Clothing" and get manager approval screenshot. Finance will require justification that it was business-essential; we may ask for insurer claim outcome to cover excess.
Leah Kim: Also keep packing lists and any customer emails showing reason for in-person presentation. If airline later reimburses, notify travel@redwood.com so we can reconcile.
Nora Blake: What about tips for the delivery driver who brought my bag?
Finance Bot: Delivery/courier tips for recovery are reimbursable if they are reasonable. Attach delivery receipt and a short note.
Leah Kim: If you used a personal phone to coordinate and incurred roaming charges, small phone charges under $20 we treat as incidental; include a note.
Nora Blake: Got it. I'll open insurer claim, file Concur with receipts + PNR and airline confirmation, and cc travel@redwood.com. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Concur mapping suggestion:
```
Expense type: Baggage Delay - Essentials
Policy code: TRV-BAGDELAY-2026
Attachments: airline delay confirmation, itemized receipts, insurer claim ID (if any), manager approval for exceptional items
Notes: list items purchased and business reason
```
